summary: FIFO history-buffer shift over two separate buffer regions of the struct. Each 16-dword record is overwritten with its predecessor, discarding the oldest record. The first region (start at 0xC8) is shifted as 4 groups of 11 records; the second region (start at 0xBC8) is shifted as 55 records.

operations.description: Initialize v1 to this + 50 dwords, i.e. the start of the first history buffer at byte offset 0xC8.
Outer do-while loop running 4 times (one pass per group of the first buffer), counting down a group counter.
Inner do-while loop over 11 records per group: copy the previous record into the current slot (*v1 = *(v1 - 1)) and advance v1 by 16 dwords each iteration.
Initialize result to this + 754 dwords, i.e. the start of the second history buffer at byte offset 0xBC8.
do-while loop over 55 records of the second buffer: copy the previous record into the current slot (*result = *(result - 1)) and advance result by 16 dwords each iteration.
Return result, the one-past-end pointer after the final copied record of the second buffer.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the shifted history records is unknown; first region holds 4 groups of 11 records, second holds 55 records.
